title: API Academy: Learn How to Learn About APIs
description: To unlock the storage chest and obtain your wand, you must learn how to learn about APIs. This is achieved through documentation.

validation_fields.name: answer1
validation_fields.label: In the [Twilio Programmable SMS API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms) documentation, find the resources for messages, media attached to messages, or Messaging Services. Enter the name of one of these resources.

validation_fields.name: answer2
validation_fields.label: In the [Message Resource](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource) documentation, enter the name of the property that contains the text of a message.
